message: Choose AI subscriptions by business task, not by hype.
audience: Local small business owners and nonprofit teams

scenes.title: The hook
scenes.voiceover: The best affordable AI subscription is not the most famous one. It is the one attached to work you already do.
scenes.eyebrow: BUY THE TASK / NOT THE HYPE
scenes.headline: Start with the work.
scenes.subhead: One useful workflow beats five unused subscriptions.

scenes.title: General assistant
scenes.voiceover: For writing, planning, and everyday problem solving, begin with one general assistant and learn it deeply.
scenes.headline: Your everyday copilot.
scenes.subhead: Draft, reason, summarize, and organize from one place.

scenes.title: Research
scenes.voiceover: When sources matter, use a research tool that shows where its answers came from, then verify the important claims.
scenes.headline: Answers need receipts.
scenes.subhead: Make citations part of the workflow, not an afterthought.

scenes.title: Compare
scenes.voiceover: Compare tools using one real task from your business. The clearest useful result wins, not the longest feature list.
scenes.headline: Run the same test.
scenes.subhead: Use your own email, plan, or customer question.

scenes.title: Adoption
scenes.voiceover: Adopt one tool for thirty days. Measure whether it saves time or improves quality before adding another subscription.
scenes.headline: Test. Measure. Keep.
scenes.subhead: A subscription earns its place through repeated use.

scenes.title: Follow
scenes.voiceover: Follow Pupukahi Tech for more practical technology guidance for local people and small businesses.
scenes.headline: Follow @pupukahi_tech
scenes.subhead: Practical technology for local people and small businesses.
